tool.title: Run the IRIS CDN export
tool.description: Dispatch `iris-cdn.yml`: the nightly change ingest or the weekly reconciliation of the IRIS CDN (`scripts/iris-cdn/run.ts`), then verify the signed release. Started with the standard GitHub CLI; the run is watched with `gh run watch`.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The repository whose workflow is run. Default: the current one.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: The branch to run it on. Default: the default branch.

outputs.name: run
outputs.description: The dispatched run; its outcome is read with `gh run watch` or `gh run view`.

selection.when: Running the IRIS CDN nightly ingest or reconciliation on demand instead of waiting for its schedule. Pass the mode with `-f mode=nightly` or `-f mode=reconcile`.
selection.limits: Needs a token that may dispatch workflows (actions: write) on the repository.
selection.cost: A CI run on GitHub's runners.

remedies.none: The workflow runs on GitHub; with no host there is nothing to dispatch. The scripts it runs can still be run locally.
